message.content: ChaeSong-hwa suggests several things for the garden once it is set up. First, she emphasizes the importance of having benches or seating areas, which she describes as "nice for people to sit and enjoy the garden." Additionally, she proposes adding a children's play area, which she sees as beneficial because it keeps the kids entertained while adults can relax. ChaeSong-hwa's suggestions reflect a comprehensive approach to enhancing the functionality and appeal of the community garden, ensuring it serves multiple purposes and provides enjoyment for various age groups.
